summary:
From examining NASA’s space mission designs, we realize that launching a spacecraft into space requires not only scientific knowledge but also a great many engineering decisions and the ability to manage resources.
 What if learners could take on the role of designing and managing a space mission themselves?
That question gave rise to Explore Together-an interactive simulation game that combines exploration, mission design, and resource management.
details: It makes children find science truly fascinating, sparking a desire to learn and explore even more.
